notes: Backends: cpu = math_bilinear.c with DELTA-001's math_delta.c for the side (single-threaded), cuda = math_bilinear_gpu.cu and math_delta_gpu.cu (device runs only), reconstruction = the FND-004 scope, bank and DELTA-001 state of the updated rows and the join rebuilt from the side states, duckdb = the join aggregate re-executed over the updated rows (DuckDB's own threads), numpy = explicit products of Python ints in object arrays.

A join update costs the side's DELTA-001 update (one copy of the side's cells plus the delta's rows) and the cross terms of the touched keys (touched keys x GA x GB x values); a reconstruction rescans every row of the changed side and rebuilds the join over every key.

Changing join multiplicities: a key move is a delete at the old key and an insert at the new one; the other side's per-key cells give the changed matches (the T2 / T1 terms); both-side updates add the dA dB term of keys touched on both sides.
